title: 2D Shapes: Triangles, Rectangles and Squares
seo_title: Grade 1 2D Shapes Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Identify simple 2-dimensional shapes (triangle, rectangle, square) of different size and in different orientation; compare and distinguish 2-dimensional shapes according to features such as sides and corners.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 shapes worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: triangles, rectangles, squares and circles, sides and corners, and sorting shapes. 100 questions with pictures and answers.
key_big: Count the sides and the corners.
key_sub: A turned shape keeps its name.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.
  • A rectangle has 4 sides and 4 square corners.
  • A square is a rectangle with 4 sides of the same length.
  • A shape keeps its name when it is big or small, or turned.

Examples

Example

A shape with 3 sides

count the sides: 3

count the corners: 3

Answer: triangle

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
A turned squareIt is still a square.
Counting a corner twiceMark each corner as you count.
Square or rectangle?A square has 4 equal sides.

faq.q: What does MATATAG Math 1 ask about shapes?
faq.a: Identify simple 2-dimensional shapes (triangle, rectangle, square) of different size and in different orientation, and compare and distinguish them by sides and corners.
Yes. It is a special rectangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It is flat and round. It has no corners. It is a circle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It is flat and round. It has no corners. It is a circle. It is small. It is still a circle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It is flat and round. It has no corners. It is a circle. Color does not change the name.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It is upside down. It is still a triangle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It is turned. It is still a triangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. A long, thin triangle is still a triangle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It points to the side. It is still a triangle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 sides. They are all the same length. It is a square.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 4 sides. They are all the same length. It is a square. It is small. It is still a square.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 4 sides. They are all the same length. It is a square. It stands on a corner. Some people say “diamond”. It is still a square.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 sides. They are all the same length. It is a square. It is turned. It is still a square.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 4 sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. 2 are short. It is a rectangle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 4 sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. 2 are short. It is a rectangle. It is standing up. It is still a rectangle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. 2 are short. It is a rectangle. It is tilted. It is still a rectangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 4 sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. 2 are short. It is a rectangle. It is small. It is not a square, because 2 sides are longer.

items.q: Which shape is a triangle?
items.e: B has 3 straight sides. It points down. It is still a triangle.
C is round all the way. The oval is stretched, so it is not a circle.

items.q: Which shape is a square?
items.e: D has 4 sides the same length. It stands on a corner. It is still a square.
A has 4 sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. It is a rectangle.

sets.title: Shapes in any size and position

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It is round. It has no corners. It is a circle. It is small. It is still a circle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It is upside down. It is still a triangle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It has a square corner. It is still a triangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 4 straight sides. All 4 sides are the same length. It is a square. It stands on a corner. Some children say “diamond”. It is still a square.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 4 straight sides. All 4 sides are the same length. It is a square. It is small and turned. It is still a square.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 straight sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. 2 sides are short. It is a rectangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 4 straight sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. 2 sides are short. It is a rectangle. It is standing up. It is still a rectangle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 4 straight sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long. 2 sides are short. It is a rectangle. It is tilted. It is still a rectangle.
It is half of a circle. It has 1 straight side and 1 curved side. It is a half circle.
It is half of a circle. It has 1 straight side and 1 curved side. It is a half circle. It is upside down. It is still a half circle.
It is half of a circle. It has 1 straight side and 1 curved side. It is a half circle. It is turned. It is still a half circle.
It is a quarter of a circle. It has 2 straight sides and 1 curved side. It is a quarter circle.
It is a quarter of a circle. It has 2 straight sides and 1 curved side. It is a quarter circle. It is turned. It is still a quarter circle.
A is half of a circle. It has 1 straight side. The quarter circle has 2 straight sides.
B has 2 straight sides and 1 curved side. It is a quarter circle. The triangle has no curved side.

items.q: Which shape is a square?
items.e: D has 4 sides the same length and 4 square corners. It stands on a corner. It is still a square.

items.q: Which shape is a triangle?
items.e: C has 3 straight sides. It points down. It is still a triangle. The quarter circle has a curved side.

items.q: Which shape is a square?
items.e: C has 4 sides the same length and 4 square corners. It stands on a corner. It is still a square.

items.q: Which shape is a triangle?
items.e: D has 3 straight sides. It points down. It is still a triangle. The quarter circle has a curved side.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Touch each side once. 1, 2, 3. A triangle has 3 sides.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Touch each corner once. 1, 2, 3. A triangle has 3 corners.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Count each side once. 1, 2, 3, 4. A square has 4 sides.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: It stands on a corner. Count all the corners, top and bottom. There are 4.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Count the long sides and the short sides. 2 + 2 = 4 sides.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Count each corner once. Do not forget the bottom corners. There are 4.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: A circle is round all the way. It has no corners: 0.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: It is long and thin. Count the sides: 1, 2, 3. It is a triangle.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: It points down. Count the corners: 1, 2, 3.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: It is small and turned. It still has 4 sides.

items.q: What is the red part?
items.e: A side is a straight line on the edge of a shape. The red line is a side.

items.q: What is the red dot on?
items.e: A corner is where 2 sides meet. The red dot is on a corner.

items.q: Which shape has 3 corners?
items.e: D is a triangle. It has 3 corners. The square and the rectangle have 4. The circle has 0.

items.q: Which shape has no corners?
items.e: A is a circle. It is round, so it has no corners.

items.q: Which shape has 4 sides all the same length?
items.e: C is a square. All 4 sides are the same. The rectangles have 2 long and 2 short sides.
B is a rectangle. It has 4 corners. The triangle has 3. The circle and oval have none.

items.q: I have 3 sides and 3 corners. What am I?
items.e: 3 sides and 3 corners make a triangle.

items.q: I have 4 sides. 2 are long. 2 are short. What am I?
items.e: 4 sides with 2 long and 2 short: a rectangle. A square has 4 sides the same.

items.q: Which has more corners?
items.e: The square has 4 corners. The triangle has 3. 4 is more than 3.

items.q: How many corners do they have?
items.e: Count each one. The rectangle has 4 corners. The square has 4 corners.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner. Go around and count each side once: 3 sides.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner. Go around and count each corner once: 4 corners.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner. Go around and count each side once: 4 sides. Count the short sides too.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner. Go around and count each corner once: 3 corners. Turning a shape does not change how many corners it has.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner. Go around and count each side once: 6 sides. If you get 5 or 7, you missed a side or counted one twice.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner. Go around and count each corner once: 4 corners.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner. Go around and count each corner once: 6 corners. Turning a shape does not change how many corners it has.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner. Go around and count each side once: 4 sides.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one corner. Go around and count each side once: 4 sides. Turning a shape does not change how many sides it has.

items.q: How many corners does a circle have?
items.e: A circle is round all the way around. It has no straight sides, so it has 0 corners.

items.q: How many sides and corners does it have?
items.e: Count the sides: 6. Count the corners: 6. A flat shape with straight sides has the same number of each. If you get 7 corners, you counted the first corner again.

items.q: How many sides and corners does it have?
items.e: Count the sides: 3. Count the corners: 3. A flat shape with straight sides has the same number of each. If you get 4 corners, you counted the first corner again.

items.q: Shape A is big. Shape B is small. Which one has more corners?
items.e: Both are triangles. Each one has 3 corners. Size does not change the number of corners.

items.q: Which shape has 6 sides?
items.e: Shape A has 6 sides. It is a hexagon. The others have 4, 4 and 3 sides.

items.q: Which shape has 3 corners?
items.e: Shape C has 3 corners, so it is a triangle, even though it is turned. A circle has no corners.

items.q: Which shape has the most sides?
items.e: Shape B is the smallest shape, but it has the most sides: 6. Count the sides. Do not look at the size.

items.q: A shape has 4 sides. How many corners does it have?
items.e: Each side ends at a corner. A flat shape has the same number of corners as sides: 4.

items.q: A hexagon has 6 sides. A triangle has 3 sides. How many more sides does the hexagon have?
items.e: 6 − 3 = 3. The hexagon has 3 more sides.

items.q: How many corners do 2 triangles have in all?
items.e: Each triangle has 3 corners. 3 + 3 = 6 corners.

items.q: How many sides do a square and a triangle have in all?
items.e: A square has 4 sides. A triangle has 3 sides. 4 + 3 = 7 sides.

items.q: Which shape is the odd one out?
items.e: D has 4 sides. It is a square. The others have 3 sides. They are all triangles.

items.q: Which shape is NOT a triangle?
items.e: B has 4 sides. It is a rectangle. Every triangle has 3 sides, any way it points.

items.q: Which shape is NOT a square?
items.e: A has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. It is a rectangle. The squares are turned, but all their sides are the same.
C is stretched. It is an oval. A circle is round all the way, big or small.

items.q: Which shape is the odd one out?
items.e: D has 3 sides. The others have 4 sides and 4 square corners. They are rectangles.

items.q: Which shape is the odd one out?
items.e: C has 2 long sides. It is a rectangle. The other 3 are squares. Color does not matter.

items.q: How many triangles can you see?
items.e: Look for 3 sides. There are 3 triangles. The turned one and the thin one count too.

items.q: How many squares can you see?
items.e: Look for 4 sides the same length. There are 4 squares. The squares on a corner count too. The long one is a rectangle.
Look for shapes that are round all the way. There are 3 circles. The stretched one is an oval.

items.q: How many rectangles can you see?
items.e: Look for 4 sides and 4 square corners. There are 3 rectangles: flat, standing up and tilted.

items.q: These shapes are in one group. What is the rule?
items.e: The colors and sizes are different. Every shape has 3 sides. The rule is 3 sides.
The colors and sizes are different. No shape has a corner. The rule is no corners.

items.q: These shapes are in one group. What is the rule?
items.e: Some are squares and some are rectangles. Every shape has 4 sides. The rule is 4 sides.

items.q: Jericho sorts shapes into 2 groups. Where does a square go?
items.e: A square has 4 sides. It goes in the 4 sides group.

items.q: Paolo uses the same 2 groups. Where does a circle go?
items.e: A circle has no straight sides. It does not go in either group.
B is a rectangle. It has 4 corners. The others have 3 corners or none.

items.q: How are these shapes the same?
items.e: One is big and one is small. The colors are different. Both have 3 sides. Both are triangles.

items.q: How are these shapes different?
items.e: Both have 4 sides and 4 corners. Both are the same color. The rectangle has 2 longer sides.

items.q: Are these the same shape?
items.e: The second one is turned onto a corner. It still has 4 sides the same length. Both are squares.

items.q: What is different about these triangles?
items.e: They are the same size and color. Both have 3 sides. One points up and one points down.
